name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v541: Phisher's exact Cloudflare WebView port. (1) Complete rewrite of CloudflareWebViewDialog to match Phisher's AnimePahe implementation exactly. (2) Fixed all WebView loading issues - now properly loads challenge page for API endpoints. (3) Cookie detection uses Phisher's exact regex (cf_clearance=[^;]{15,}) and detection logic. (4) Invisible mode uses CloudStream's proven alpha=0 attach pattern with touch passthrough. (5) Both visible and headless modes use Phisher's exact WebView settings (clean UA, mixed content, multiple windows, file access, images). (6) Fixed toggle inversion - 'Hide Cloudflare WebView' now correctly controls visible/invisible mode. (7) probeAndResolveIfNeeded actually shows bypass WebView when Cloudflare detected. (8) Cookies saved to all AnimePahe hosts + kwik.cx. (9) 30s fail-fast timeout, kwik.cx in bypass, cleared in-flight on dismiss, background init.
